title: The golden LBO sheet inserts a new 'Total Interest Expense' row at row 179, which pushes every row from 179 down by one. A correct fix that puts the missing total in the existing empty row 179, or anywhere else, without inserting a row leaves dozens of cells misaligned and fails the all-cells-must-match check.
evidence: Input LBO B181='Sponsor Equity', B187='Returns Analysis', rows 179-180 empty. Golden B179='Total Interest Expense' (=SUM(G175:G178)), B182='Sponsor Equity', B188='Returns Analysis', D213 sensitivity table shifted to rows 213-218. G67 in golden =-G179.
